description: Move one delivery that is still queued to another time in the future. Refused with 409 once it is being sent or has been sent. Each account of a post is its own delivery.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

id.description: A delivery id from publish, schedule or jobs_list.

scheduledAt.description: Future UTC timestamp ending in Z (e.g. 2026-11-06T14:00:00Z), converted from the workspace time zone (see usage_get).

name: jobs_reschedule
title: Move a scheduled post
